Gold.note: Central bank demand and anticipated rate cuts support prices despite recent pullback.

Silver.note: Strong solar panel demand and structural deficit offset recent price weakness.

Copper.note: Tight concentrates and strong electrification demand drive a structural deficit.

Uranium.note: Persistent primary supply deficits and renewed global nuclear capacity additions.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new global projects outweighs steady EV demand growth.

Nickel.note: Massive Indonesian supply growth continues to overwhelm sluggish stainless steel demand.

Zinc.note: Concentrate shortages and smelter treatment charge collapses tighten the market.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in Chinese property construction suppresses steelmaking demand.

Coal.note: Thermal coal demand peaks while seaborne supply remains adequately stocked.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls provide a floor, but weak EV motor demand caps upside.

Manganese.note: Soft Chinese steel production limits manganese alloy demand despite supply tightness.

PGM.note: Tight South African power grid and recycling shortages support platinum over palladium.

Potash.note: Balanced global application rates and normalized supply chains keep the market stable.

Aluminum.note: Chinese capacity caps and strong automotive lightweighting demand tighten the balance.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper and iron ore provides resilience amid mixed macro signals.
